candidate.source_summary: The 'o' parameter (target object) and 'objects' parameter (source objects) are passed to the defaults function. Values come from function arguments without validation.
candidate.sink_summary: The function recursively merges properties into the target object 'o'. If attacker-controlled objects contain special properties like __proto__ or constructor, they could pollute the prototype chain.
candidate.guard_summary: The is-plain-object dependency (v0.1.0) may not properly detect prototype objects. No validation of property names or prototype pollution guards present. The for-own dependency iterates over own properties but recursive merge enables deep prototype pollution.
candidate.risk_pattern: Recursive merge of nested objects without prototype pollution protection allows attacker-controlled objects to modify Object.prototype through specially crafted property paths.
candidate.context_summary: The function performs deep merge of objects by recursively copying properties from source objects to target. The changed line enables recursive merging when both target and source values are objects.
